name: Tochibora mine, Kamioka — Hyper-Kamiokande cavern
notes: No latitude/longitude was published in any source read on 2026-09-16. The coordinates are derived: the Super-Kamiokande GPS position from the SK detector paper, moved 8 km south, following the PoS(ICRC2021)1192 statement that the Hyper-K site is "approximately 8 km south of the Super-Kamiokande site". precision_m is set accordingly.

summary.plain: A newly excavated cavern 600 metres underground in the Tochibora part of the Kamioka mine, about 8 kilometres from Super-Kamiokande, being prepared for the much larger Hyper-Kamiokande detector.
summary.technical: Underground site under Mt. Nijuugo-yama in the Tochibora mine; 69 m diameter by 94 m high dome-capped cylindrical cavern, 600 m below surface, 650 m of rock overburden at the detector centre, at the same 2.5 degree off-axis angle to the J-PARC beam as Super-Kamiokande.
